name: subnetcalc-electron
description: High-precision IPv4 & IPv6 Subnet Calculator Desktop Application with FLSM, VLSM, CIDR Summarization, Multi-Cloud VPC Profiles, and 25 Theme Families

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder -p never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg:x64 -p never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg:arm64 -p never
scripts.dist:mac:all: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 -p never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64:all: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 -p never
scripts.dist:mac:universal: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --universal -p never
scripts.dist:win: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --win -p never
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 -p never
scripts.dist:win:ia32: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --win --ia32 -p never
scripts.dist:win:all: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --ia32 -p never
